# WordPicker

WordPicker is a free browser extension (Chrome/Edge/Safari) for English learners. Hold a modifier key and hover over any English word to get instant definitions. Save words to WordBase cloud wordbook with SRS spaced repetition review.

## Target Users
- Chinese speakers learning English
- Developers reading English documentation
- Students reading academic papers in English
- Anyone who wants to build vocabulary while browsing

## Key Features
- Hover lookup: Hold modifier key (Ctrl/Cmd/Alt/Shift) and hover over English words for instant definitions
- WordBase cloud wordbook: Save words to cloud, sync across devices, never lose vocabulary
- SRS spaced repetition: Smart review algorithm based on forgetting curve
- AI definitions: Context-aware definitions powered by AI
- Fireworks effect: Visual celebration when saving new words
- Offline dictionary: Built-in ECDICT dictionary, works without internet
- Cross-browser: Chrome, Edge, Safari support via Manifest V3
- Completely free: No ads, no paid features

## Technical Details
- Built with TypeScript, Manifest V3, webextension-polyfill
- Backend: Supabase Auth + WordBase API (Cloudflare Pages)
- Offline dictionary: ECDICT
- Translation: MyMemory + Youdao fallback
- Open source: https://github.com/bayernjf/word-picker

## Use Cases
- Reading English documentation (MDN, Stack Overflow, GitHub)
- Reading academic papers (arXiv, Google Scholar)
- Code review on GitHub (hover over words in comments/docs)
- Reading English news (BBC, Reuters)

## Comparison
- vs Saladict: WordPicker adds cloud wordbook, SRS review, AI definitions, Safari support
- vs QuillBot: WordPicker adds hover lookup, offline dictionary, SRS review, completely free

## Links
- GitHub: https://github.com/bayernjf/word-picker
- WordBase: https://word-base.pages.dev
